title: BELT ROUTING
summary: Accessory drive belt routing (fan belt / serpentine-free V-belt layout) for the 350 engine: base engine, LT1 (with A.I.R. smog pump), N40 power steering, L46 with N40, C60 air conditioning, and C60 with N40. Gives factory belt tension specs for 3/8 and 15/32 belts and the A.I.R. pump belt, checked with a Burroughs gauge BT-33-95.
notes: Initial tension: 3/8 belts 125 ± 5 lbs; 15/32 belts 140 ± 5 lbs.

CAUTION: when re-tensioning a previously installed belt after part replacement or repair, use 75 ± 5 lbs for 3/8 belts and 95 ± 5 lbs for 15/32 belts (these are the residual figures a new belt settles to by shipment).
Initial A.I.R. pump belt strand tension 75 ± 5 lbs (settles to about 60 lbs by shipment).
Check belt tension with a Burroughs Gage BT-33-95.
A = 1ST TRACK, B = 2ND TRACK, C = 3RD TRACK (crankshaft pulley groove).
notes_internal: Diagram page: no part callouts. Table lists which accessories each belt letter reaches, read from the drawings; exact wrap order not recorded.
Belt A in every layout drawn from the crankshaft up to the generator with its upper strand running to the water pump pulley; recorded as C/SHAFT, WATER PUMP, GENERATOR.
Model box reads 19000 ("350" ENGINE); the 454 routing is on A5.
Unlabeled first diagram taken as the base engine.
RPO L46 WITH RPO N40: belt B drawn crossing from the top of the water pump pulley down to the P/S pump; whether it also wraps the crankshaft is unclear.
Title block: DR WO/C1, CK 4-18-69 C1, PREL 3-28-69, C/O A5 (sic). Sideways 'K185'. No revisions.
